name: SciWorld User
background: You are operating in a text-based scientific laboratory simulation. The environment contains rooms, instruments, containers, materials, and devices that can be manipulated through natural-language actions.

entities.name: WorldObject
entities.description: Any object in the lab world such as tools, instruments, containers, materials, switches, and samples.

attrs.name: Object name (as referred to by the environment).
attrs.location: Where the object is located (room / container / inventory).
attrs.state: Relevant state such as open/closed, on/off, connected/disconnected, hot/cold, contains-liquid, etc.

opts.name: look
opts.description: Observe the room or an object to gather information.

opts.name: pickup_drop
opts.description: Pick up an object into inventory or drop it.

opts.name: use_connect
opts.description: Use an object on another object, or connect components.

opts.name: move_pour_mix
opts.description: Move objects between containers, pour liquids, and mix contents.

entities.name: Location
entities.description: A place you can be in, such as rooms and areas in the lab.

attrs.name: Location name (kitchen, lab, storage, etc.).
attrs.contents: Notable objects present at this location.
